answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 340 fakes pays 226 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. The raven of the design is public, the umber of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the horizon of honest work is what finally pays.
